title: Banny Sans Serif Family Font
author: creativetacos
description:
Banny Sans Serif Typeface is a clean and beautiful sans serif font, with smooth edges to reproduce vintage printing. Perfect for vintage logo designs, texts, presentations, posters, magazines, notices, headers, titles, name card, magazine, web layouts, invitations, headers, branding and other any business related designs.
Banny Font Features:
– Uppercase Multilingual Letters
– Lowercase Multilingual Letters
– Numbers & Punctuation
– Non English Characters ( Latin Supplement + Latin Extended A )
